notes: Matched-agent parity (Scenario 3: the original benchmark uses a custom agent). Both sides run ContractBench's own tool-calling loop: natively in the original harness (agents/docker_runner.py at the original_parity_repo revision), and in Harbor as contractbench-parity-agent@1.0.0 (src/contractbench/parity_agent.py), a port that keeps the system prompt, bash tool definition, temperature 0.0, max_tokens 16384, 30 model calls, the soft deadline (600 s, matching the original side's run_task_docker.py --timeout 600), 60 s per-command limit and 30,000-character output truncation. Original side: run_task_docker.py --docker --agent gpt-4o --k 3 --temperature 0.0 --timeout 600 at e8b94270, 2026-09-03 05:09-07:12 UTC; every trial records the requested model openai/gpt-4o and the harness does not record the snapshot. With the same key, all 1,926 Harbor responses to openai/gpt-4o from 2026-08-30 to 2026-09-03 05:32 UTC (overlapping the original run) report gpt-4o-2024-08-06, as does a gpt-4o request on 2026-10-27 (evidence/model_alias/ in the parity upload). Harbor side: Harbor 0.25.0, tasks generated by adapter commit 21c6e14 (1e81571 after rebasing; before the task-server sidecar and separate verifier), 2026-10-27 04:39-05:12 UTC, requesting gpt-4o-2024-08-06 explicitly; every response reports it. Task sources: instruction, server, shared helpers, solution and tests are byte-identical between the original harness's harbor/tasks at e8b94270 and the adapter's harbor/cookbook-export at c50eefee; the model-visible differences are the stripped footer and the benchmark-name scrub. Scored trials: original 99/99, Harbor 99/99. Per-task: no task is solved on only one side; 28 of 33 tasks have identical pass counts across the 3 runs and the other 5 differ by one run. Order: original side ran a 6-task sanity check, a full run that lost one task to a harness decoding bug, a 3-run job aborted after one trial by a teardown bug, then the reported 3-run job; Harbor side ran a 6-task sanity check, one full run, then two more full runs. The 3 Harbor trials of retry-backoff-compliance first ran at the upstream default 300 s deadline, reached it and scored 0; they were rerun at 600 s and again scored 0 (ending at the 30-call cap like the original side). No other Harbor trial reached 300 s. Every attempt is listed in LEDGER.md / ledger.json of the parity upload. Scope: these numbers were measured on the 21c6e14 tasks and were not re-measured on the final revision (task-server sidecar, separate verifier). Carrying them forward rests on byte-identical agent-visible inputs, no parity trajectory touching the hidden files, oracle 33/33 and a 6-task diagnostic (5/6 matching the prior majority), not on three new full runs. The original side's gpt-4o-2024-08-06 snapshot is corroborated by overlapping same-key responses, not recorded by the original harness. Harbor-side cost $15.49 (sanity check, 3 runs and the 3 rerun trials, from recorded token usage); original side about $22 at list price from logged token counts.
